data.description:
## Description

**What**: Author the gov-copy artifact schema contract at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/gov-copy-artifact.md.
**Why**: All downstream consumers (gov-copy-writer agent, deterministic post-processor, coordination-pass, dogfood harness) bind to this schema; without it they cannot interoperate.
**Scope**:
- IN: YAML schema (per-item `values` { label, hint, errors{} }, `rationale` { rule_ids[], conflicts[], deviations[{rule_id, reason}] }, `checks` { fk_grade, banned_words_found, active_voice }); top-level metadata (schema_version, epic_id, generated_by, generated_at); file naming convention; YAML validator; passing and failing examples
- OUT: agent that produces the artifact (separate story); post-processor that computes checks (separate story)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, plugins/dso/docs/contracts/gov-copy-artifact.md exists with per-item `values`, `rationale`, and `checks` blocks defined to the field shapes named in the epic
  ← Satisfies: sc-3 (sc-3: "gov-copy-writer produces a YAML copy artifact conforming to the schema"), sc-4 (sc-4: "items carry values/rationale/checks computed deterministically")
- When this story is complete, the contract documents that the `checks` block is computed by deterministic post-processing rather than LLM self-attestation
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, a YAML validator accepts a conforming artifact
  ← Satisfies: sc-3, sc-4
- When this story is complete, the YAML validator rejects an artifact missing rationale.rule_ids or with a malformed checks block
  ← Satisfies: sc-3, sc-4
- When this story is complete, the contract document includes at least one passing example artifact and one failing example with the rejection reason
  ← Satisfies: sc-3, sc-4
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations
- [Interoperability] Consumed by the agent, post-processor, coordination-pass, and dogfood harness.
- [Forward-compat] Reserve fields for future canon-source attribution beyond rule_ids.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO skill author, I have a versioned gov-copy artifact schema so producer and consumers share a strict shape
